insertRedeemKey.sql:
INSERT INTO sms_redeem_keys(
              id, inventory_item_id, sku_id, code_fingerprint, status,
              sms_service, sms_country, sms_min_price, sms_max_price, sms_min_count,
              sms_phone_exception, cdk_valid_days,
              issued_at, expires_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (#{id},#{inventoryItemId},#{skuId},#{fingerprint},'UNUSED',
              #{service},#{country},#{min},#{max},#{minCount},#{phoneException},#{validDays},
              NOW(3), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{validDays} DAY), NOW(3))
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `inventory_item_id`=`inventory_item_id`

findKeyByFingerprintForUpdate.sql:
SELECT k.id, k.inventory_item_id AS inventoryItemId, k.sku_id AS skuId, i.import_batch_id AS batchId,
                   k.code_fingerprint AS codeFingerprint, k.status,
                   k.sms_service AS smsService, k.sms_country AS smsCountry,
                   k.sms_min_price AS smsMinPrice, k.sms_max_price AS smsMaxPrice,
                   k.sms_min_count AS smsMinCount, k.sms_phone_exception AS smsPhoneException,
                   k.cdk_valid_days AS cdkValidDays,
                   k.issued_at AS issuedAt, k.expires_at AS expiresAt, k.used_at AS usedAt,
                   k.failed_at AS failedAt, k.attempt_count AS attemptCount,
                   k.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, k.created_at AS createdAt, k.updated_at AS updatedAt,
                   i.secret_ciphertext AS secretCiphertext, i.status AS inventoryStatus
            FROM sms_redeem_keys k
            JOIN inventory_items i ON i.id = k.inventory_item_id
            WHERE k.code_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
            FOR UPDATE

isCdkAmbiguous.sql:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM redeem_cdk_registry
            WHERE business_kind='SMS_REDEEM' AND code_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND inventory_count > 1)

lockInventoryStatus.sql: SELECT status FROM inventory_items WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

findActiveSessionId.sql:
SELECT id FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId}
              AND status IN ('PENDING_NUMBER','WAITING_CODE','ACQUIRE_UNKNOWN','CANCEL_PENDING')
            ORDER BY attempt DESC LIMIT 1

markKeyFailed.sql: UPDATE sms_redeem_keys SET status='FAILED', failed_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status <> 'DISABLED'

insertSession.sql:
INSERT INTO sms_sessions(id, redeem_key_id, attempt, status, updated_at)
            VALUES (#{id},#{keyId},#{attempt},'PENDING_NUMBER', NOW(3))

lockKey.sql: UPDATE sms_redeem_keys SET status='LOCKED', attempt_count=#{attempt}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status <> 'DISABLED'

markSessionUnavailable.sql: UPDATE sms_sessions SET status='UNAVAILABLE', completed_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}

startAcquisition.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET acquisition_started_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING_NUMBER' AND acquisition_started_at IS NULL

markStaleAcquisitionsUnknown.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET status='ACQUIRE_UNKNOWN', updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE status='PENDING_NUMBER' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)

markSessionAcquireUnknown.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET status='ACQUIRE_UNKNOWN', updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING_NUMBER'

markSessionCancelPending.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions
            SET status='CANCEL_PENDING',
                activation_id=COALESCE(#{activationId}, activation_id),
                phone=COALESCE(#{phone}, phone),
                activation_cost=COALESCE(#{cost}, activation_cost),
                cancel_refund_attempt=#{refundAttempt},
                updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id}
              AND status IN ('PENDING_NUMBER','ACQUIRE_UNKNOWN','WAITING_CODE')
              AND (activation_id IS NULL OR activation_id = #{activationId})

rollbackAttempt.sql:
UPDATE sms_redeem_keys SET
              status=(CASE WHEN status IN ('EXPIRED','USED','FAILED','DISABLED') THEN status
                           WHEN attempt_count<=1 THEN 'UNUSED' ELSE 'LOCKED' END),
              attempt_count=GREATEST(0, attempt_count-1), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}

markSessionWaitingCode.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET activation_id=#{activationId}, phone=#{phone}, activation_cost=#{cost},
              status='WAITING_CODE', cancel_refund_attempt=0, cancel_eligible_at=#{cancelEligibleAt},
              number_expires_at=#{numberExpiresAt}, updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING_NUMBER','ACQUIRE_UNKNOWN') AND activation_id IS NULL) OR (status='CANCEL_PENDING' AND cancel_refund_attempt=1 AND activation_id=#{activationId}))

listPhones.sql:
SELECT phone FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId} AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone <> ''
            ORDER BY attempt ASC

listSessionSummaries.sql:
SELECT attempt, phone, status, activation_cost AS activationCost,
                   sms_code AS smsCode, CAST(sms_codes AS CHAR) AS smsCodes,
                   sms_text AS smsText, next_sms_code AS nextSmsCode
            FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId}
            ORDER BY attempt ASC

findLatestSuccessSessionId.sql:
SELECT id FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId} AND status='SUCCESS'
            ORDER BY attempt DESC LIMIT 1

findLatestSessionWithPhoneId.sql:
SELECT id FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId} AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone <> ''
            ORDER BY attempt DESC LIMIT 1

findReusableSessionId.sql:
SELECT id FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId} AND attempt=#{attempt}
              AND status IN ('UNAVAILABLE','CANCELLED','FAILED')
            LIMIT 1

resetSessionPending.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET status='PENDING_NUMBER', activation_id=NULL, phone=NULL,
              activation_cost=NULL, sms_code=NULL, sms_codes=NULL, sms_text=NULL, next_sms_code=NULL,
              next_listen_until=NULL, provider_finalized_at=NULL,
              cancel_eligible_at=NULL, number_expires_at=NULL, completed_at=NULL, updated_at=NOW(3)
              , acquisition_started_at=NULL, cancel_refund_attempt=FALSE
            WHERE id=#{id}

markSessionCancelled.sql: UPDATE sms_sessions SET status='CANCELLED', completed_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}

findSessionIdByActivationForUpdate.sql:
SELECT id FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE activation_id=#{activationId} AND (status IN ('WAITING_CODE','SUCCESS')
              OR (status='CANCEL_PENDING' AND NOT cancel_refund_attempt))
            ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

markSessionSuccess.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET status='SUCCESS', sms_code=#{code}, sms_text=#{text},
              sms_codes=CAST(#{codesJson} AS JSON), next_sms_code=NULL, next_listen_until=NULL,
              completed_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id} AND (status='WAITING_CODE' OR (status='CANCEL_PENDING' AND NOT cancel_refund_attempt))

markKeyUsed.sql:
UPDATE sms_redeem_keys
            SET status='USED', used_at=COALESCE(used_at, NOW(3)), updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id} AND status='LOCKED'

startNextListen.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET next_listen_until=#{until},
              number_expires_at=GREATEST(COALESCE(number_expires_at, #{until}), #{until}),
              updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id}

appendSmsCode.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET sms_code=#{code}, sms_text=#{text},
              sms_codes=CAST(#{codesJson} AS JSON), next_sms_code=NULL, next_listen_until=NULL,
              updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id}

markProviderFinalized.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET next_listen_until=NULL, provider_finalized_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id}

clearNextListen.sql:
UPDATE sms_sessions SET next_listen_until=NULL, updated_at=NOW(3)
            WHERE id=#{id}

findRedeemKeyId.sql: SELECT redeem_key_id FROM sms_sessions WHERE id=#{id}

sessionView.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.redeem_key_id AS redeemKeyId, s.attempt, s.phone, s.status, s.cancel_refund_attempt AS cancelRefundAttempt,
                   s.sms_code AS smsCode, CAST(s.sms_codes AS CHAR) AS smsCodes,
                   s.next_sms_code AS nextSmsCode,
                   s.next_listen_until AS nextListenUntil,
                   s.provider_finalized_at AS providerFinalizedAt,
                   s.cancel_eligible_at AS cancelEligibleAt,
                   s.number_expires_at AS numberExpiresAt, s.completed_at AS completedAt,
                   s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt,
                   k.status AS keyStatus, k.attempt_count AS attemptCount,
                   k.expires_at AS keyExpiresAt,
                   k.sms_service AS smsService, k.sms_country AS smsCountry
            FROM sms_sessions s
            JOIN sms_redeem_keys k ON k.id = s.redeem_key_id
            WHERE s.id=#{id}

listExpiredKeyIds.sql: SELECT id FROM sms_redeem_keys WHERE status IN ('UNUSED','LOCKED') AND expires_at <= NOW(3) LIMIT 200

listTimedOutWaiting.sql:
SELECT id, redeem_key_id AS redeemKeyId FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE status='WAITING_CODE' AND number_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND number_expires_at <= NOW(3)
            ORDER BY number_expires_at LIMIT 50

listTimedOutSuccess.sql:
SELECT id, activation_id AS activationId FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND provider_finalized_at IS NULL
              AND ((number_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND number_expires_at <= NOW(3))
                OR (next_listen_until IS NOT NULL AND next_listen_until <= NOW(3)))
            ORDER BY COALESCE(next_listen_until,number_expires_at) LIMIT 50

listCancelPending.sql:
SELECT id, redeem_key_id AS redeemKeyId, activation_id AS activationId
            FROM sms_sessions
            WHERE status='CANCEL_PENDING' AND activation_id IS NOT NULL AND activation_id <> ''
            ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT 50

markKeyExpired.sql: UPDATE sms_redeem_keys SET status='EXPIRED', updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('UNUSED','LOCKED')

insertEvent.sql:
INSERT INTO sms_events(id, redeem_key_id, session_id, event_type, detail_json)
            VALUES (#{id},#{keyId},#{sessionId},#{type},#{detailJson})

countKeysByStatus.sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS cnt FROM sms_redeem_keys GROUP BY status

countUsedToday.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sms_redeem_keys WHERE status='USED' AND DATE(used_at) = CURRENT_DATE

countFailedToday.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sms_redeem_keys WHERE status='FAILED' AND DATE(failed_at) = CURRENT_DATE

countRedeems.sql:
<script>
            SELECT count(*) FROM sms_redeem_keys k
            WHERE (#{filter}='' OR k.status=#{filter})
            <if test="sessionStatus != null and sessionStatus != ''">
              AND (SELECT s.status FROM sms_sessions s WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1)
                  = #{sessionStatus}
            </if>
            <if test="cdkFp != null and cdkFp != ''">
              AND k.code_fingerprint = #{cdkFp}
            </if>
            </script>

pageRedeems.sql:
<script>
            SELECT k.id, k.status, k.attempt_count AS attemptCount, k.sms_service AS smsService,
                   k.sms_country AS smsCountry, k.issued_at AS issuedAt, k.expires_at AS expiresAt,
                   k.used_at AS usedAt, k.failed_at AS failedAt, i.import_batch_id AS batchId,
                   i.id AS inventoryItemId, sk.name AS skuName,
                   k.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode,
                   k.code_fingerprint AS codeFingerprint,
                   (SELECT s.phone FROM sms_sessions s WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastPhone,
                   (SELECT s.status FROM sms_sessions s WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastSessionStatus,
                   (SELECT s.sms_code FROM sms_sessions s
                    WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id AND s.sms_code IS NOT NULL AND s.sms_code != ''
                    ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastSmsCode,
                   (SELECT s.sms_text FROM sms_sessions s
                    WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id AND s.sms_code IS NOT NULL AND s.sms_code != ''
                    ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastSmsText,
                   (SELECT s.next_sms_code FROM sms_sessions s
                    WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) AS nextSmsCode,
                   (SELECT MIN(s.created_at) FROM sms_sessions s WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id) AS firstUsedAt
            FROM sms_redeem_keys k
            JOIN inventory_items i ON i.id = k.inventory_item_id
            LEFT JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = i.sku_id
            WHERE (#{filter}='' OR k.status=#{filter})
            <if test="sessionStatus != null and sessionStatus != ''">
              AND (SELECT s.status FROM sms_sessions s WHERE s.redeem_key_id=k.id ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1)
                  = #{sessionStatus}
            </if>
            <if test="cdkFp != null and cdkFp != ''">
              AND k.code_fingerprint = #{cdkFp}
            </if>
            ORDER BY k.created_at DESC
            LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
            </script>

listDisplayPhones.sql: SELECT phone FROM sms_sessions WHERE redeem_key_id=#{keyId} AND phone IS NOT NULL AND cancel_refund_attempt=0 ORDER BY attempt

listAutoExcludedAreas.sql: SELECT prefix FROM sms_voip_area_exclusions WHERE active=1 ORDER BY prefix

addAutoExcludedArea.sql: INSERT INTO sms_voip_area_exclusions(prefix,line_type) VALUES(#{prefix},#{lineType}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=1,detection_count=detection_count+1,line_type=VALUES(line_type),updated_at=NOW(3)

autoExcludedAreas.sql: SELECT prefix,line_type AS lineType,detection_count AS detectionCount,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sms_voip_area_exclusions WHERE active=1 ORDER BY prefix

addManualExcludedArea.sql: INSERT INTO sms_voip_area_exclusions(prefix,line_type,detection_count,active) VALUES(#{prefix},'manual',0,1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=1,updated_at=NOW(3)

deleteExcludedArea.sql: INSERT INTO sms_voip_area_exclusions(prefix,line_type,detection_count,active) VALUES(#{prefix},'manual',0,0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=0,updated_at=NOW(3)
